name: Foundry v13 adapter — core-API profile
description: Runs Foundry VTT modules through AIS. Profile foundry-module loads an unmodified module.json distribution (ES modules via blob URLs + import map) and maps Foundry core APIs — settings, i18n, modules, notifications, hooks, active-scene documents, transient FX, the application UI (0.3.0: Application/FormApplication/Dialog, ApplicationV2/DialogV2, Handlebars templates and jQuery-style listeners drawn inside the module's own sandboxed panel) and (0.4.0) ArenaStar's own core resource library — the templates/*, COMMON/SETTINGS/DOCUMENT language keys, base CSS and foundry.data.fields/DataModel that modules expect Foundry core to provide — and (0.5.0) the world documents (game.actors/items/journal/tables/macros/folders/playlists/combats/users, Document create/update/delete with embedded Items/ActiveEffects/Pages/Combatants, flags, fromUuid, pre*/create*/update*/delete* hooks fed by replication) onto AIS services; profile foundry-v13-scene-tags-fx keeps the 0.1.0 bundled-guest behaviour. Never Foundry core code, never the parent renderer. Approve each guest separately.
